configuration.dataset: sklearn load_digits; real UCI handwritten digits
configuration.checkpoint_selection: lowest held-out validation cross entropy; test untouched until selection
configuration.timing_boundary: rnn forward plus linear head, input already normalized, excludes model load and disk IO
configuration.parameter_budget: same hidden width, different parameters; not a matched-parameter benchmark

hardware.scope: warm forward, actual held-out handwritten image already normalized; excludes model load, preprocessing and disk IO; no GPU/NPU measurements

aggregate_method: Three fixed training seeds on one fixed stratified split; percentages and sample SD (n=3), not confidence intervals or independent data splits.
